title: Website design and development
content:
A website is a collection of linked, publicly published pages. Web pages can be created by an individual, group, company, or group and created for different purposes. The World Wide Web consists of all websites that are made available to the general people. Although sometimes referred to as a "website", this definition is incorrect as a website has many pages. 

Creating a new website requires a lot of skills, two of which are designing and developing websites. Since these two things are important in the process of creating a new website, these two terms may seem changeable. Today, I will look at some of the differences between designing and developing websites and discuss how they work together to achieve amazing results on websites.

Internet design relates to the beautiful parts of a website and its usefulness. Web designers use a variety of project programs, such as Adobe Photoshop, to create web settings and other graphics.

Web developers, on the other hand, eliminate website design and creation. Web developers apply design files using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and other programming languages.

 

Web design

A Web design company begins their website creation process by considering the purpose of the customer website, then proceeds to the information architecture (IA) to create the website as per their standards. The web designers can then start to build the website’s skeleton and finally proceed to the project section. They use basic design techniques to create beautiful designs that give a better user experience.

A web designer is involved in viewing, configuring, and modifying the contents of a website. The layout refers to how the files are sorted and separated. A well-designed website is easy to use, beautiful and fits the user group and site type. Many websites are designed for easy maintenance so that no external data or features bother or disturb users. Since the key to designing a website is to gain the trust of the target audience, it is important to eliminate as many potential users as possible.

Responsive and adaptive design are two simple ways of website design that work best on computers and mobile devices. In the feedback format, the content is dynamically moved according to the size of the screen; In custom design, web content is measured in the same layout size as the specific screen size. Maintaining user trust and maintaining engagement is essential to maintain uniform distribution across devices. Since reactionary ideas are difficult in this case, designers need to be careful when leaving control over how they view their work. If they are also responsible for the content, they need to expand their skill pack, but they can also take full control of the finished product.

Design principles

 

  • Designers of balance sheets should make an equal appearance. In web design, we are talking about complex objects (large and dark colors) and light (small colors and light). For each user level, it is important to achieve a consistent website design.
  • Contrast - In color theory, contrasting colors are opposite colors on the color wheel (see also additional colors). Web design offers other areas where there is contrast. Designers look at contrasting sizes, textures and shapes to define and focus on specific parts of the web page.
  • Energy production - We explained some differences when we talked about this topic. The main emphasis is on design and aims to "highlight" some of the most important elements in website design. It is important to remember that if you focus on everything in your work, you should not focus on anything. Imagine a page in a book where 80 contents are displayed in yellow ... Is there anything to see here?
  • Sustainability: Repeatedly Contribution is an important part of web design. For example, a clean and consistent route provides the best experience for your website visitors.
  • Unity - Unity is the relationship between the various parts of web design and the overall structure. According to Gestalt theory, unity belongs to the way the human brain processes information by simulating objects in groups.

Website development

Web developers sometimes called programmers, design and build a complete website. Just (really) think of design as an unrelated "image" of the web. The designers took this design and divided it into different parts. Then they just use HTML as a platform for programming languages ​​like PHP to develop different websites. Successful web developers may want to use a content management system (CMS) such as WordPress and Joomla to improve development, keep customers up to date.

Website developers can use images and content indicators, link and button activity patterns, and other interactive elements to transform static layouts into dynamic web pages. Although the terms "web development" and "web designing" are often used conversely, they have different meanings. Technically, web designers use coding languages such as HTML, CSS to design web servers. Web developers can be involved in web design, but they are capable of writing web pages in languages ​​such as PHP and ASP. Besides, web developers can help and update the archive that works just like custom web pages.

The construction of the site involves a variety of traps on the feet. Some examples include writing website code, text to create a program like Dreamweaver, and page modifying the blog itself. In recent years, content management systems like WordPress, Joomla Extensions have become a popular way to improve a website. This will make it easier to design and customize your website for online devices.

Although there are many ways to create a website, there is usually a trade-off between simplicity and personalization. As a result, most of the large companies do not use content management systems, but they have web development teams to design and maintain their websites. Organizations and individuals can opt for additional solutions such as WordPress, which support web design and easily customize the tool.

What is a frontend development?

The frontend of the website is the part used by the user. Everything you see as you browse the web, from fonts and colors to drop-down menus and scrollbars, is a combination of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript driven by your computer's browser.

Web developers are concerned with designing code-oriented and code-oriented web pages for a pleasant experience. To achieve this goal, the developer must have three main languages: HTML, CSS, and Javascript. In addition to being fluent in these languages, intermediate developers should have links to programs such as Bootstrap, Foundation, Backbone, AngularJS, and EmberJS, which offer good visual-free tools, as well as libraries such as jQuery and LESS, handy wrapping code. Many editing tasks also require information from Ajax, a widely used Javascript method that makes pages more dynamic by reloading server data.

Using this tool, pioneers ultimately work with a designer or user experience analyst to display a model or wireframe from progress to delivery. Powerful production leaders can accurately identify specific problems in a user environment and provide coded recommendations and solutions that affect the design. It is important to be able to easily work with other teams throughout the company and implement these recommendations to understand specific goals, needs, and opportunities.

The front-end programmer is doing everything currently displayed on this site. The designer created the logo and graphics, the photographer took the picture, and the editor wrote the text. However, the interface picked up all these songs and turned them into online calls, creating all the page experiences. To give a concrete example, scroll up and down the Udacity website. Did you notice that the "U" disappears and reappears? That's the job of the interface developer.

What is backend development?

Backend Development points out to that part of development where the primary focus is given on the working of the website. In addition to monitoring the performance of the site, it also engages itself with the updates and changes that are to be made. This part of web development contains three parts: a server, an application, and a database. The code written by the backend developer transfers the information stored in the server. Anything you can’t see easily with the eye such as databases and servers is the work of a backend developer. People who are engaged in the process of backend development are often called programmers or web developers. Developers then re-design and maintain the technology that drives the materials that make up the design of the site for the face in the first place.

To launch server services, applications, and databases for communications, the developers use languages ​​that are suitable for servers such as PHP, Ruby, Python, Java, .NET, and MySQL applications. Tools like MySQL, Oracle comes in handy for operations such as to restore, store or modify data and return it to the user in advance with the number. Delivering work to new developers often requires experience with PHP methods like Zend, Symphony, and Cake PHP. Experience with control software like SVN, CVS, or Git is preferred along with experience in developing and maintaining with Linux.

Backend giants use these tools to create or assist web applications with clean, portable, and well-written code. But before writing this code, they need to work with business stakeholders to understand their specific needs, then translate them into technical requirements and provide the most efficient and effective information about the technology system.

What is full-stack development?

 

Full-stack development deals with the development of both the front (client-side) and back (server-side) sections of web applications. Full-Stack web developers are capable of developing complete web applications and websites. They work on the front and back pages of web applications or websites, databases, and bug fixes.

Skills related to full-stack development:

It takes a lot of effort to learn how to qualify oneself as a genuine programmer. Here’s a piece of quick information about different coding languages that can be learned:

HTML & CSS

To get started with your web development work, you need to have a basic knowledge of HTML and CSS. These are the basics of web design that allow you to add content and style to your web pages. Start your journey towards becoming a full-fledged developer by gaining a good understanding of these above ideas.

JavaScript

Using front and back JavaScript is very popular. It is the hottest technology on the market, with constant inventions. Good knowledge in this area is required as new tools and frameworks open each year. Identifying JS frames like AngularJS and ReactJS will help you write long codes easily. Knowledge of jQuery is an additional bonus while learning the aspects of JavaScript.

Additional languages -

After finding a solid background in Html, CSS, and JavaScript, the next language will be Ruby, Python, PHP, and so on. These languages provide an insight into the logical management, user analysis, and data activation of a website. It is always preferred to start with a language that is easy to learn. Whatever language you choose, let it be subtly completed. You can learn NodeJS based JavaScript before learning the database and security components of a website.

title: WEB DESIGN AND DEVELOPMENT
content:
A website comes into existence because of the collaboration of a web designer and web developer. If you are a newbie who wants to create his website then knowing website design and development is very necessary. Web design and development can be termed as different branches of the same tree. Website design deals with the content of a website making it appealing to the site’s visitors. On the other hand, the development of a website focuses on the functionality of a website thereby increasing the overall user experience. Before knowing about web design and development we must know about a website and its importance.

 

What is a website?

                A website is an identity that highlights the presence of either an individual or an organization in the vast world of the internet. It is a collection of pages that are merged to represent oneself in the most viable way. There are millions of websites available on the internet today that are designed to serve different purposes. A website comprises a common domain name and is published on a particular webserver to make it accessible to the users of the internet. 

A website can prove to be advantageous in a lot of ways. Some of the advantages of having a website are mentioned below:

                 ⦿ It serves as an intermediary for the business of providing foreign information to foreign customers.

                   ⦿ Available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

                   ⦿ Provides an easy way to communicate between buyers and sellers.

                 ⦿ It works as a great way to market your channel on social media and build community with your customers.

                 ⦿ It is found all over the world.

                 ⦿ This helps to sell more and therefore reach more customers.

                 ⦿ Helps increase conversion rates.

                 ⦿ It can help companies promote their products or services.

                 ⦿ In the modern modern world, a trustworthy online presence of any company is assumed.

                 ⦿ Having a website saves you a lot of time because everything you need is in one place և you can see them all at any time.

                 ⦿ Offers a simple way to serve customers.

                 ⦿ The site provides as much detail about your business as it does in the future.

 

              With the rapid advancements in digital technologies, one may find it easier to create a website because of the availability of website builders and content management systems. Using either of the platforms one can create a website to make it serve its purpose. If you aren’t interested in creating your website then you can go to your nearest web design company to help you with your troubles. There are a lot of website creators that can be found today because of the popularity of websites. People known as freelancers are also engaged in the process of website designing and their developmental activities. 

If you are confused between selecting a freelancer or web design company our article o Website designing company in Jorhat to get some help.

 

What is website designing?

               Website designing refers to the transformation of an idea into a visually appealing design that suites the purpose of your website. It is the process of creating a layout that can be used by the developers to turn it into a fully functioning site. Web designers face a hard time while trying to implement a design as they need to integrate the best user experience and a welcoming environment for the user. To create a great website one must apply a proper design strategy in its early stages because without a great user experience and design the website won’t get any appreciation from its users. The work of a web designer was underrated earlier but nowadays they are rated at the same level as web developers. If we think about designing a website it might seem simple but there are a lot of difficulties that lie ahead in this process. Even after knowing the features and specifications required for a website one must proceed strategically to present the best-suited design. Web designers start their designing process with a scope which is the focal point and the purpose of the website. At first, they create a rough sketch of the design then they proceed towards wireframes, mock-ups, and the final design. Professional web designers use design components for their designing process where they create a pixel-perfect layout of all the website components. 

If anyone is interested in designing a website then the following points must be kept in mind:

              ⦿ One must have sound knowledge of graphics designing

              ⦿ The design should be achieved in such a way that it attracts the user’s eyes

              ⦿ To achieve a successful design the elements of the website should be kept simple and they must perform their desired functions     

              ⦿ Web design trends change from time to time. One must keep themselves up to date with the latest trends to create a website that familiarizes itself to the user’s eyes.

              ⦿ A great design consists of a perfect balance between the displaying colors, its typography, and the readability of the website.

Tools used in Web designing:

Every profession utilizes a certain set of tools to bring its concepts into reality. There are a lot of applications that serve the purpose of website designing. A small list of tools that are involved in the web designing process are mentioned below:

                 ⦿ WordPress:

WordPress is the most common web design tool that is available on the internet today. It is widely used by numerous designers all across the globe because of its simple and easy-to-use features. It provides a lot of options to edit and optimize a website that suits the needs of the designer. 

                 ⦿ WeBotApp Master:                     

WeBotApp Master software is designed and developed by India Web Designs. It acts as a content management system, customer relationship manager, enterprise resource planner, and also account management software. It is a user-friendly platform that allows one to design beautiful websites with a lot of additional features.  

                 ⦿ Photoshop:

It is a popular tool for creative designers who are involved in designing beautiful artworks. It can act as a vital tool in designing authentic websites allowing one to create amazing prints and patterns in their projects. With the mastery of photoshop, one can design websites faster than the other web design tools.

                 ⦿ Adobe Dreamweaver:

It is an impressive design tool put forwarded by adobe that enables a user to directly code the website design without having any knowledge of programming. It comes with a lot of features that can be utilized to create a responsive web design. Using this software allows one to optimize a website without affecting the experience of the website user.

                 ⦿ Google Web Designer:

Google Web Designer helps you in creating beautiful and attractive HTML5 content. One can use animations and social media platforms to increase the site’s visibility and have fun with other Google products, like Google Drive, Revelation & Video 360, and Google Ads.

 

What is Web Development?

             A great design is not enough to craft a successful website. There are a lot of areas other than designing the website contents which are essential in building a great website. Web development is the work that is done behind the scenes to make a website look great. It is the work that goes into maintaining a website while making it work fast and perform better along with providing a great user experience. 

         Web development can be further categorized as: 

                   ⦿ Frontend Development:

              Frontend development deals with the interface of the website turning the crafted designs into a live website. It generally creates a  layout that acts as a link between the backend of the website and its user. The languages that are used in frontend development are HTML(Hypertext Markup Language), CSS(Cascading Style Sheets), and JS(JavaScript). These languages are used in developing the visual interface of the website. This part of website development gives importance to the elements of the website and their placement in the website layout. 

                  ⦿ Backend development: 

               Backend development deals with the data that is available on the website. A database connection is important to store the user-generated data or the general data present on a website. The backend consists not only of the database but also the server that hosts the website. It handles operations such as CMS development, server & network securities, scripting the client-side & server-side, etc. Backend development can be achieved with numerous coding languages such as PHP, MySQL, ASP.NET, Ruby, Python, etc. There are more backend coding languages as compared to frontend. It is because browsers understand only JavaScript whereas backend development can be configured to understand almost any kind of coding language.

              People who are interested in both frontend and backend development must consider the role of a full-stack developer. A full-stack developer takes care of both the frontend and backend part of a website. These people are capable of creating a website using codes along with maintaining the database queries of the website. A full-stack developer is an expert of all languages who possesses a basic knowledge of design and user experience. Web Technologies are evolving every day and it is very necessary to keep oneself up-to-date with these advancements to excel in the field of web design and development. 

Conclusion:

             With the advancements made in the field of internet technologies, people have developed different strategies to overcome their workload. A website these days serves the purpose of promotion and also provides an attractive way to present oneself in the internet world. With the increasing needs of a website, the areas of website design and website development are gaining popularity. If someone wants to create a website and does not know these areas then they must seek an expert who is well-versed with the terms of web design and development.           ⦿  Website Development Services

          ⦿  Search Engine Optimization Services

 

When we make a certain query on search engines we click on the results that are shown to us on the first search page and avoid scrolling through the other pages. 

And that’s a fact.

It is not enough to create a website today for your business growth. One must employ certain techniques to increase the visibility of your website to gain more users. A website must be ranked among the top search queries to increase the number of visitors coming to the site. This process of ranking a website using different methods is called Search Engine Optimization or SEO in short. It is a very important aspect that must be looked upon while maintaining your website. Being an affordable web design company in Kolkata we also offer SEO services for your website. 

 

WHAT IS SEO

As we have already mentioned SEO stands for Search Engine Optimization. It refers to the process of improving your website to increase visibility for relevant searches. With an increase in the site’s visibility, it will accumulate more attention thereby attracting potential customers that require your services and products. 

SEO is all about understanding what people are searching for online, the answers that they want, the words they are using, and the type of content they are looking for. There are two sides of attaining SEO for a website, knowing about the audience’s intent is one side while making it known to the search engines is the other side. Search engines have access to all the information on the internet and they provide you with the best results for the queries that are made through them. This process of accessing and providing results is known as crawling and indexing. The process of arranging the results for the users is called ranking. If you are interested to know more about these processes of crawling, indexing, and ranking you can search for them on the internet which will provide you with better knowledge. 

 

IMPORTANCE OF SEO

SEO is an important part of digital marketing that helps in reaching the desired amount of potential customers. It is one of the many methods used in digital marketing to increase the visibility and ranking of a website. The team employed for a company’s SEO efforts will analyze and improve their website by implementing different techniques to increase the overall ranking for certain topics and keywords. 

Several elements must be known and utilized in the right way to understand the importance of SEO and to increase the ranking of a website. The elements of SEO are briefly discussed below to help one get an idea of how SEO is implemented:

 

      ⦿  Keywords

         Keywords are words or phrases that are used in search engines to make a certain query. If you have a web designing company in Kolkata then examples of keywords might include Kolkata web design company, website design company in Kolkata, web design Kolkata, web design company in Kolkata, Kolkata web design, Kolkata website design company, Kolkata web design company list, best web design company in Kolkata, web design company Kolkata, top 10 web design company in Kolkata, an affordable web design company in Kolkata, etc.

         There are a lot of keywords that might relate to a particular company, but it isn’t necessary to rank higher in all of them. One must choose the keywords that have a higher search rate to increase the website’s overall ranking. Keyword research is an important aspect when it comes to optimizing a particular website for higher rankings against its competitors.  

 

      ⦿  Content

         Content refers to the descriptive information that is shown to the customers to help them get a better view of the services provided or products supplied by any business. The content of a website must relate to the services and products of its organization. Content has a variety of forms such as blogs, web page content, infographics, videos, and more.  

 

      ⦿  Local SEO

         Due to the increased usage of mobile devices and the internet, local SEO has turned out to be an important element in SEO implementation. Most of the searches made today are based on the intent of finding them locally. Along with using local keywords this SEO element also employs techniques such as creating location-specific pages, creating spaces in Google My Business, etc. 

 

      ⦿  Off-page SEO

         Off-page SEO is an element that involves external optimization practices. The strategy behind achieving off-page SEO is backlink building. The quality backlinks from external websites will inform the search engines that the website is valuable and high quality which in turn binds authority. 

 

      ⦿  Search Engine Marketing (SEM)

         Search Engine Marketing refers to the paid marketing efforts made to increase the rank of a particular website. It includes a lot of things like Google Adwords, PPC, display ads, etc. SEM might not be a comprehensive SEO strategy but it has its place in Search Engine Optimization as it can help in reaching new and targeted audiences.


 

TYPES OF SEO

Now that we are familiar with SEO and its importance let’s dive ahead in the pool of SEO types. SEO can be divided into 7 different types which are discussed below to help you understand SEO better and the techniques associated with it:

 

      ⦿  WHITE HAT SEO

         This form of SEO mainly focuses on abiding by google’s search engine guidelines while optimizing a website. The results of using this SEO type might be slow but they are sustainable and will reduce the risks of getting banned. This SEO practice includes techniques like creating relevant content after doing extensive keyword research, earning high authority backlinks, etc. If done right this SEO type might provide one with high rewards while eliminating the risk factor associated with a website’s promotion and reputation.  

 

      ⦿  BLACK HAT SEO

         Black Hat SEO is the exact opposite of White Hat SEO. It is a process that searches for loopholes in the search algorithms to rank better in search engine queries. It doesn’t follow the search engine guidelines and employs methods such as keyword stuffing, cloaking, spammy links, etc. This form of SEO involves a high-risk factor besides getting your site blacklisted. Using this form of SEO can also result in the demotion of a website’s ranking, so it is best left undisturbed until and unless one requires a faster way of achieving their desired SEO goals.

 

      ⦿  GREY HAT SEO

         This mode of SEO utilizes both Black Hat and White Hat SEO techniques to show quick results to a customer. Although the methods of Grey Hat SEO are not prohibited by the google guidelines, they can still lead to undesired outcomes. This SEO approach uses techniques such as excessive link exchanges between sites, paying for reviews, etc. This kind of SEO tactics might seem helpful but are best left untouched to attain a better reputation in the search engines.

 

      ⦿  NEGATIVE SEO

         Negative SEO is the most unethical approach seen in SEO. It is done to drop down the competitors ranking to take their place and benefit from it. This form of SEO includes tactics like hacking into a particular website to build a high number of low-quality links, posting negative feedback in various online forums, etc. Practicing this form of SEO might lead to legal trials if the practitioner gets caught. So this form of SEO should not be utilized as it is the most hated SEO technique.

 

      ⦿  ON-PAGE SEO

         On-page SEO is a technique that follows certain methods to optimize the website pages. This form of SEO primarily helps search engines and users to have a better understanding of your website and its content. Tactics used in this form of SEO include providing high-quality content for the sole purpose of helping site visitors, decreasing the number of broken links and duplicate content, adding meta tags for google bots, etc. The on-page SEO, all in all, deals with the measures that are taken to make a web page rank higher in the search engines.

 

      ⦿  OFF-PAGE SEO

         Off-page SEO refers to the methods that are utilized outside a website to increase its visibility and ranking in the search engines. It includes the process of creating backlinks and online mentions of the website. It can also be achieved by taking an active part in the forums, having a successful social media marketing campaign, getting positive reviews from the customers, etc.  

 

      ⦿  TECHNICAL SEO

         This form of SEO deals in the optimization of websites to a point that makes it easier for the bots to crawl, interpret, and index a website for future use. Technical SEO mainly works on the backend of a website to help it run better and achieve a better rank. It is very important to maintain a faster loading time for the web pages to load and a responsive web design that can adapt itself to any device be it a smartphone, tablet, or other such devices. Technical SEO is mainly focused on the site’s performance to increase the number of visitors and its accessibility.

 

         That was a brief description of Search Engine Optimization, its importance, and the types of SEO. Knowing about SEO is not enough to increase the ranking and visibility of a website. The techniques discussed above must be employed in the right manner to achieve the desired outcome. If one doesn’t know the correct utilization of the above-mentioned techniques then an expert must be sought to stay away from the negative effects of employing these tactics.

We have a team of experienced professionals in the matters of SEO to help you promote your activities over the internet. If you have any further queries related to SEO consult with us for a better view of its use and importance.

The city has developed itself to deliver robust business and economic benefits to the city residents. The important industries in the other sectors are dairy, chemical, manufacturing, and textiles. Handicraft and small industries are also available sides by side. The tourism sector also puts an impact on the city's economy. Gwalior is one of the CMA’s to New Delhi to dissipate a load of urbanization from NCR. While one adapts to the so-called new-age tech, it is crucial to maintain an online presence to reach one’s, potential customers. When it involves highlighting your online presence, there are several things that you simply need great consideration. Basically, the act of building your online presence doesn't simply end by just creating an internet site for your business and/or company. Most, if not all, websites have achieved success through their online marketing efforts, by utilizing the proper SEO tactics and constantly feeding it with the proper elements. It may not provide you with immediate positive outcomes, but in due time, it'll surely make progress.

 

What is Web Design?

 

Web Design is a process of planning, designing, and arranging contents online. It generally refers to aspects of the user experience in web development rather than software development. Earlier web designing use to focus on desktop browsers, now web designing includes web apps, mobile apps, and other user interface design

 

A web designer works on the appearance, design, and in some cases the content of the website. Appearance, for example, is related to the color, font, and images used. Planning refers to how information is organized and classified. A good web design is easy to use, aesthetically pleasing, and adapts to both the user group and the brand of the website. Many web pages are designed with an emphasis on simplicity so that they do not display superfluous information and functions that could distract or confuse users. Since the cornerstone of a web designer's production is the site that earns and reinforces the trust of its target audience, it is critical to eliminate as many potential points of user frustration as possible.

 

Two of the most popular ways to design websites that work well on both desktop and mobile devices are responsive and responsive design. In responsive design, content moves dynamically based on screen size; In an adaptive layout, website content is pinned with layout sizes that match common screen sizes. Maintaining as consistent coordination as possible between devices is essential to maintain user trust and engagement. Since responsive design can present difficulties in this regard, designers must be careful not to control the appearance of their work. If they are also responsible for the content, although they may need to expand their skill set, they will enjoy the advantage of having full control over the final product.

How to design a Website

 

In the past, web designers had to create their websites from scratch by writing every line of HTML and CSS code for each website they made.

With so many things available on the internet today, you can be a designer without knowing any of the coding stuff because of the availability of website builders and Content Management Systems like WordPress. These website creation tools perform the hard work of creating the code so that one can use their basic computer skills (dragging things around with your mouse, clicking buttons, copy/paste) to generate a website of their own. The process of designing a website as performed by our team at India Web Design is noted in the points below:

 

 

  • The idea is the most important ingredient in web design as it defines the end goal. It is a visual from where to start and where to end.
  • Creativity is connected with Ideas. Creativity brings an idea from the spiritual world to the physical world where it is visible to everyone. 
  • After bringing the Client’s requirement or Idea to the physical world, the next step is to research the demand of the client’s competitors. The purpose of the research is to know the idea’s scope and the competitor’s weakness to make it stronger for our client. 
  • We buy a domain name of your preference and then buy hosting from a trusted hosting provider. 
  • After the research and knowledge about the scope and competitor’s weakness, our next step is to draw the idea and make it visible which is called design. Our team of professionals draws the design of the whole website and makes it visual. 
  • If a business is totally new, then definitely it will need a visual presence and that is Logo. If you don’t have a logo for your business, then our professional designer designs a brand identity for your website. 
  • At this stage, our developers along with the help of our designers start working to develop the website according to our client’s requirements. Once each and everything is finalized, we launch the website and take the feedback from our client and revise accordingly until the client is satisfied.

 

You need the right set of tools to get you going on the journey of creating a website. A small but detailed analysis of how to design your website using various CMS software is provided below to help you get started.

 

1. How to design a website in WordPress.

WordPress was publicly made available on May 27, 2003, by American developer Matt Mullenweg and English developer Mike Little. WordPress (WP, WordPress.org) is a free open-source content management system (CMS). It can also be used as a blog-publishing system but also supports other web content types. It is operated by more than 60 million websites, as of January 2021. WordPress software is known to be among the best content management system solutions. Given below is a list of points to help you get started with WordPress:

  • Find a domain name for your site.
  • Sign up for web hosting. 
  • Get WordPress installed.
  • Pick a free WordPress theme. 
  • Get those WordPress plugins that will help with your site growth.
  • Begin creating your pages and blog posts.

 

2. How to design a website in photoshop

In the world of web design, a website mockup is a highly précised simulation of how a website will look. Website mockups combine the structure and logic of a wireframe but with the images, graphics, and UI elements, providing a summary of your website. Photoshop can be termed as the best in creating mockups. You can only work with raster files within PS, so anything that is exported (JPG, PNG) cannot be interacted with. Most of the points regarding the use of photoshop as a website editor tool are discussed below. Most of them:

  • Create a page in Photoshop. Every page must be built individually.
  • Using the Slice tool, snip out the elements with which you want to be interactive.
  • From the menu select: File > Export > Save for Web (Legacy)
  • Adjust settings as you have desired
  • Click Save
  • Select the destination folder (put it in a self-contained folder)
  • Look for the Format dropdown. Select HTML and Images.
  • Click Save.

The rest:

  • Open the HTML file in Dreamweaver.
  • Select the slices and add the links as seen fit.

 

3. How to design a website in HTML

HTML (Hypertext Markup Language) provides the content structure and meaning by defining the content. CSS or Cascading Style Sheets is a presentation language used to style the appearance of content. The two languages ‘HTML and CSS’ are not dependent on one another. The rule that should be followed while using these two is that “CSS should not be written inside an HTML document and vice versa”. The points regarding the process of creating a website using Html and CSS are mentioned below:

  • Learn the HTML basics
  • Understand the HTML document structure
  • Get to know about CSS selectors
  • Put a CSS stylesheet together
  • Get Bootstrap
  • Pick a design
  • Customize the website with HTML and CSS
  • Add content and images
  • Fine-tune colors and fonts
  • Create additional pages

 

4. How to design a website in Adobe XD

Adobe XD is a prototyping tool developed by Adobe to develop designs by interaction designers to create the best user experience. Adobe XD can be used to create a mockup website to visualize your website concept. The features of Adobe XD are utilized in creating wireframes, prototypes, and screen designs for all sorts of digital products such as websites and mobile apps. There are a lot of templates available within the software to choose from. Once you are done creating the prototype version of your website you will require a web design tool like Dreamweaver or muse to publish your website. 

5. How to design a website in asp.net using c#

ASP.NET, developed by Microsoft, acts as an open-source web framework. It has its uses in building modern web apps and services. NET. It is a cross-platform that runs on Windows, Linux, macOS, and Docker.   • Run and test a page from Visual Studio.

It’s quite simple to create a website without the use of codes. Anyone can build a website; all it requires is a small amount of your time and dedication. Business without discipline is a nightmare. With so many businesses growing around one needs to be extra careful while running a business. ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) helps you in achieving these objectives in a planned manner & an ERP software development company can provide you a tool that will allow customization of these objectives according to your requirements.

Benefits from an ERP software development company

An ERP software development company is responsible for creating software that enables the smooth functioning of businesses. Running a business can be quite stressful because of so much data that comes along with it. A business owner needs to maintain the following three points to run a business successfully:-

  • Proper planning: 

Proper planning can be beneficial in reducing the risk of uncertainties and in saving time as well as expenses. The role of a business ERP software comes into existence to achieve this objective of proper planning. While an ERP software development company builds software for you where you shall set up various information such as present financial positing, your goals, present expenses, present turnover, etc. In certain cases, the software shall auto-suggest various data based on the previous year’s inputs, taking into consideration which you can set or plan your upcoming goals of the organization.

We can also call execution an operation. It is easy to plan, but not that easy to execute, right? But, if there is a proper system of work and you train your employees a proper flow of action in operations, it becomes easier to operate. After practicing the operations for a while, we all form a habit of following those actions autonomously. Monitoring without help can be difficult and time-consuming. As a result, your performances may not match up to your level of expectations. title: 7 Compulsory Checks To Promote An Interior Design Business
content:
Are you an interior designer and planning to launch or promote your interior design business? 

Are you looking for new and modern ways to market your interior design business and reach our new customers as far as possible?

 In this article regarding "7 Compulsory Checks To Promote An Interior Design Business", we shall try to eliminate all of your queries and provide you the best and proven strategies to market your brand. Let's get started!

Basic concepts of marketing to learn before promoting an interior design business.

The very simple meaning of marketing is to identify the demand of the customers and reach them with the most appropriate product or services. If the offered product or service is valued by the customers, then only it can be traded for money. Interior designers are people who have the experience of designing indoor spaces appealingly. Hiring an interior designer for your indoor spaces can be helpful to decorate those spaces in functional, safe, and beautiful ways. The main three reasons for people to hire an interior designer are:

  • To get professional advice on upgrading the look of his premise.
  • To get a person who can decorate his/her premise in a scientific and disciplined way.
  • To save time and money.

Of course, several other factors come into play but we have considered these primary factors. Hence, people who prefer working in a disciplined and scientific way, people who prefer to save their precious time, and people who prefer to decorate their premises with help of a professional are your direct customers. These segments of customers are very useful in promoting an interior design business. 

Now, the question is how do we get those potential clients? 

This is one of the most crucial questions for many professionals who don't have the exact answer about promoting an interior design business.

Methods of Advertisements To Promote An Interior Design Business:

We have a lot of methods to promote an interior design business but all of these methods do not have the same importance. If we maintain the pillar methods and monitor them at regular intervals of time, we will be successful in promoting an interior design business in any part of the world. These methods are discussed below:

  • Method 1 - Listing your interior design business on Google My Business:

Google My Business, is a free tool for all business owners. All you need to do is to list your interior design business on Google My Business, create a profile by filling up all necessary details, and most importantly update your profile at regular intervals of time. If you simply create an account and do not update regularly, you won’t be visible on Google My Business. You can post new articles on your Google My Business page regarding new interior design ideas, concepts, how to save money and time, etc.

  • Method 2: Approach a few of your friends and relatives and offer service for free: 

Once you are ready to launch and promote any interior design business, get in touch with your close friends or relatives and ask them if they have any plans of renovating their office or residential interior. You can share a few ideas with them about the changes and modifications that can be done, and try not to take any charge for a few projects. This will help you to build a portfolio that you can show to your upcoming clients who are interested in working with you. Once your job is over with your first free clients, request them to post a good descriptive review on your Google My Business page. These reviews will help you to gain trust from potential clients in the near future.

  • Method 3 - Build a website: 

Once you have got a few clients whether free or paid and some genuine reviews on Google local listing page, you are ready to get professional. In this stage, you need to hire a website designer or a web development company who is successful in delivering quality websites to their clients. You need to design a properly structured website along with a mobile responsive layout and an admin panel from where you can update your website from time to time. The website should have a well-written company profile with contact details, Google Map, Portfolio, Social Media Links Integration, and a specially designed blog. content:
Are you planning to outsource your website development project to a web development company in India? Are you looking for website development cost in India? If yes, we have everything covered for you. In this article regarding website development cost in India in 2020 for creating a new website, we have researched various small and large website development companies in India and gathered the information you are looking for.

Website Development Cost in India, in 2020

This is a very serious topic with a large of variables to be considered in order to establish a report in a straight line. However, based on various interactions we had with our customers, we have produced a list of website types which are most popular in 2020. So, in order to explain you the various factors determining the website development cost in India, we present you the following summary in bullet points.

Various types which determines the website development cost in India in 2020

  • One page websites = $250 - $450
  • Static 5-7 Page Websites = $750 - $999
  • Dynamic 5-7 Page Websites = $1500- $2500
  • Ecommerce Websites = $3000 - $5000

There are uncountable number of web development companies in India, right from a single person or freelancer operated web development company to a multinational web development company. These web development companies offer website design services, website development services, mobile application development services, software development services, internet marketing services and so on. Based on the experience, market exposure and existing client base, the web development companies in India sets pricing for the services. Now, the website development cost in India is dependent on the web development company you approach for doing your next website development work.

But the most important factor which determines the website development cost in India is:

The type of website you are going to develop. There are several types of websites and the time taken to develop different type of websites are different. So, most of the web development companies charge their clients according to the number of hours they need to work on a particular project. For example, if you are going to develop a website which is of one page and 5 sections, in that case an experienced website designer would take 4-5 hours to complete your project. Therefore, website development cost in India for developing a one page website with 5 section would be around 5 hours multiply by $50-$90 (per hour).   On the other hand if you are going to build a website which should have the options to modify the contents of your website from your end, in that case the website development cost in India for developing a CMS based website would be around $1500 - $2500. This is because time taken for a web development company or a website designer to create a dynamic CMS website is around 30 to 50 working hours and where the rate per hour is around $50 -$90.

What are the different types which determines the website development cost in India?

There are several types of websites. Some of these types are mentioned below:

  • Static website design
  • Dynamic website design
  • E-commerce website development
  • Mobile website development
  • We portal development
  • Matrimony or dating website development
  • Job portal development
  • And so on

Lets discuss the each and every types of websites which are popular now and the cost to develop such websites:

  • One Page Static Website Development Cost in India: There are situations when you are in a tight budget. For some unavoidable reasons, you need to have a website for your organisation but you are not sure whether you would keep it for a permanent basis. Even there are situations, when you need a website for such an organisation, which do not needs frequent updates. In that case, you can choose to have a single page static website with parallax layout. It is the most economical website packages in India and the one page static website development cost in Indian is around $250 - $450.
  • Multipage Page Static Website Development Cost in India: Well, you may have an organisation with limited number of products and services and the prices or product features do not change so often, in that can you can have a multipage static website. The most important reason to choose this plan is "If you need a website where there will be very limited updates or you do not have sufficient man power to update the website at your work place". But if you have a time or man power to update the website from your own end, from time to time, in that case, it is better to have a dynamic website which uses modern CMS or content management systems such as Wordpress or custom made. Multipage static website development cost in India is somewhere between $750-$999.
  • Multipage Page Dynamic Website Development Cost in India: One of the most popular websites of this age is multipage dynamic website with CONTENT MANAGEMENT SYSTEM. CMS helps you to update the contents of your website with help of a visual editor like Microsoft Office without learning a single bit of code. People loves CMS websites because, it saves hundreds of your dollars in case of updating the website on future time, as it can be done from the clients end. Dynamic Website Development Cost in India charged by experienced professionals is something between $1500 to $2500.
  • E-commerce Website Development Cost in India: E-Commerce is the present and the future of all business houses. During the recent times, we have noticed that all physical businesses are compelled to shift online in order to sustain their businesses. It is therefore, one of the most powerful tool of today's businesses to bring a better tomorrow. E-commerce website development cost in India charged by experienced professionals is something between $3000 - $5000 if you have a product range more than 50.

If you make a deep research to find out website development cost in India, you shall also find certain websites which will charge you $100 for developing an e-commerce website.

Those advertisements seems so real like a fat loss program in 7 days! But is it possible?

In almost every country, we can see cheap website development services but I wonder how can one manage to offer professional services at competitive rate? Professional services requires years of experience and dedication in work. Unfortunately, one cannot offer quality services at cheap rate.

Website Development & Business Development - Co-relation:

This is one of the most vital factors determining website development cost in India. Before developing a website, we must know that a website is one of the most valuable digital assets of your organisation. What can a good website do for you?

  • First and foremost, it is the digital library of your organisation, your entire business is represented by a website. So the more informative it is, the more information you are sharing about your business with your potential customers.
  • It brings in new sales. It is obvious that, if you can display all of your products and services with the potential customers explaining its advantages and benefits, no one can stop your products from being purchased.
  • It helps business to tie up with B2B partners: Every business owners aims to tie up with large corporate partners, who are in need of the products in bulk volume and in regular basis. A good website will encourage your customers, to get in touched with you. Once they get in touch with you, they are your most potential lead.

Therefore, we can see that there is a very close relationship between website development and business development. A website developer or a website development company without understanding the main objective of your organisation, wont be able to help you in getting benefited from your website. Hence, the website development cost in India or abroad also depends on the the knowledge and experience of the service provider on your domain. It is not so necessary that the service provider must have all the information or knowledge you have about your business but he should have the basic concept what your operation is, who are your competitors, your target age group of customers and so on.

10 Crazy Things To Know How Website Design Works!

  1. Choosing a great domain name: For a common people, a website is something which has a www as a prefix and dot com as a suffix. So before you choose your next domain name, try to get a dot com domain name. Dot com is still the default domain name for most of the people.
  2. Deciding the concept of a website:  There are several types of websites such as a content based website, an e-commerce website, a blog, a forum, a classified website, a web portal, and so on. Therefore, before going to build your own website, you must know how website design of each single type works or what are are primary objectives of each of these types of websites. For example, if you have a small business where you offer services, in that case it would be better for you if you just build an information based website to let your customers know about your services. On the other hand if you are grocery shop owner and planning to sell your products to the customers near your shop, in that case you need an e-commerce website. But if you are a very new businessman, build an information based website at first, once you start gathering sales from it, upgrade it to an e-commerce or a web portal.
  3. Most of the website owners do not use their website: A website is the most powerful tool in this area to increase your sales online. We have seen many business owners have got a website, but literally they do not use it the way it should be. Updating it regularly with useful contents will help Google to understand the the website has valuable contents and gradually its rankings will start getting improved on Google Search. You must not be a pro person who knows how website design works but if you get a content management system (CMS) website, you will be able to update your website with ease.
  4. Role of contents: While most of the website owners prefers a website with a great look what we call it as a user friendly UI. But on the other hand Google loves those websites with fresh and descriptive contents. In this regard, how website design professional you have hired, advised you in these area is also of great importance. Moreover, you should never copy a single line of content from any website which has already been published. If you do so, your website will get negative score in SEO.
  5. Google spiders secretly crawls your website: There is a mechanism of Google and other popular search engines, which keeps on crawling the pages of websites to find how informative the website or the page is. If you want to know how website design works perfectly, you must learn about google spiders and robots.
  6. More visitors increases Google SEO rankings: Thats true! The more number of visitors you get on your website, popular search engines like Google will consider that the website has a valuable content for the users, and it shall boost your website's SEO rankings.
  7. More Bounce Rate will Harm Your Website's Rankings: If you aim at seeking detailed knowledge how website design works, you must never ignore the concept of bounce rate. If a website visitors lands on your website, could not find any useful information or could not find a proper navigation system may press the back button of the browser or close the browser. This situation is termed as bounce rate. This is the reason why, you should produce fresh and engaging contents with clean navigation.
  8. Too much expectation is bad for your website: Your website is a technology tool but not a magic wand. There are various website owners who designs a website with a lot of expectations but when it's time for regular update of fresh contents, it's nothing. Unless, you update your website with useful contents, your website will be a useless tool as it is not a magic wand.
  9. I need a Taj Mahal at low cost: There are certain website owners who needs Amazon or Netflix at Rs 10,000 or $200 USD. How can someone expect a giant website at the cost of a static website? But the funny thing is that, free or cheapest things are disasters. Developing a web portal, following all the standards requires numerous protocols and this is not the method how website design works.
  10. Call to actions are more important than quality content: Last but not the least crazy things to know how website design works. Call to action is simply a highlighted message which is repeatedly displayed on the website on various places. It may be your contact number or email, signup / register button, etc. It does not matter how beautiful your website is but if you don't have call to actions, you wont get much sales.

  1. Company profile and contact information
  2. All of your services and packages which you offer
  3. Additional services and benefits which the customers can avail from you.
  4. Pages should display all social networks, google map for easy navigation to your business, contact form, phone number, email address, etc.

Once the basic essential parts of a travel agent website design is fulfilled, its time to get into the advance step. In this part we will be talking about the way, how contents should be displayed. Contents in travel agency website means the services that the travel agent offers or the tour packages which he offers to his clients.

 

Arranging Contents & Menu Items In order to display the contents, we should at first develop a design draft for arranging and accumulating the contents. We will be taking an example of a generic travel agency business to explain the step in a better way. For example, ABC Travel Agency offers services such as Hotel Booking, Flight Booking, Bus Booking & Tour Packages In the next step, you need to categories all sorts of hotels with whom you a a tie up such as Hotel Booking - Local Hotels, Domestic Hotels, International Hotels. Flight Booking can be further categorized to Domestic flight booking and International Flight Booking. Articles should never be copied from any other online sources and most importantly it should have the proper keywords on the right places such as the title of the article, article slug or url, etc.

 

Arranging Images: As far as possible , try to use your own images. In travel blogs people are inspired by your photographs too, so use your photographs wisely. If you do not have enough of professional photographs with you, in that case you can also get in touch with your local photographers or buy stock images too.

 

Choosing a Great Theme: A great idea to design an awesome travel agency website is to choose a great website. Very popular website themeforest contains one of the best collection of html and wordpress themes for travel agencies which you can go through. If you have a a good budget and sufficient time frame, we always recommend you to develop your own theme instead of using a purchased theme.

 

Set up of Lead Capturing Forms: Lead capturing forms are those forms which are present in the websites with main objective of capturing your visitors leads. It is one of the most important tools to essential for a travel website design. Once the application of direct advertiser is filled and sent to truecaller team for verification, they will analyze your request and if you are eligible, they shall send an email which will contain a link to set your truecaller password for accessing the ad manager account and you shall gain access to the truecaller advertising network.

Set a strong password and log into the ads manager account with the login credentials which you have just created. 

 

 

Step 4: Create Your First Ad –

 

Once you have logged into the Ads Manager account, click on create an ad button. 

 

 

Step 5: Set Up The General Settings –

 

In this step you have to create or select a new ad campaign, give a new name to the campaign and select ad product.

Step 7: Set Frequency Capping –

The last and final step is to upload your creative and make the payment.

Being a web design company in Guwahati, we always suggest you invest your business step by step. For example, if your business products and services changes often then you need to develop and CMS or content management system enabled website where you can edit your website on regular basis without incurring any extra charges but if you are dealing with any product or service which does not need to be updated, then you can get a static website.

 

According to Google's point of view, you need to update your business at regular intervals of time, so a budgeted CMS based website may also be better than a static website even if your products and services do not change too often. Once all information related to your business put together in a disciplined way in the form of a website, your website designer should submit the website to the google search console for getting displayed in Google SEO results.

 

As a website designing company in Guwahati, we submit all information related to your business to the Google search console so that the search engine robots can find vital information related to your business and make your website top priority while considering which website to index first.

 

So, get in touch with India Web Designs, share your business information, and let your business widely visible to the worldwide web. Call or Whatsapp us at +91 7002 484 119.

We seek to establish relationships based on transparency, perseverance, mutual trust, and integrity with our employees, clients, and other business partners. India Web Designs is one of the leading website design company in India that provides professional digital solutions such as website design and development, software development, mobile application development, digital marketing services, and artificial intelligence development. With the vision of providing a premium user experience for our customers, we started our journey in 2012 from India. Since then, the company has been developing countless websites and portals including digital marketing services and applications, for various clients in the world including the United States, Australia, United Kingdom, Germany, Malaysia, Colombia, Jamaica, Nigeria, Indonesia, United Arab Emirates and so on. Our strong after-sales support makes us one of the largest web design firms in Northeast India.

title: नए NGO के लिए धन / अनुदान कैसे प्राप्त करें?
excerpt: Want to read this article in English? <...
content:
Want to read this article in English? Click here

नए एनजीओ के लिए धन प्राप्त करना एक आसान काम नहीं है, सरकार की अधिकांश वित्त पोषण एजेंसियों या मंत्रालय हमेशा एक योजना या अनुदान को मंजूरी देने से पहले नए एनजीओ की पात्रता की जांच करते हैं। तो, सवाल यह है कि यदि आपका एनजीओ नया है तो आप अनुदान कैसे प्राप्त कर सकते हैं? 
उपरोक्त प्रश्न का उत्तर काफी सरल है यदि हम इसे निम्नलिखित उदाहरण से संबंधित हैं।

उदाहरण शुरू होता है: एक युवा है जिसका नाम अजय है। अपने 12 वीं कक्षा को पूरा करने के बाद वह नौकरी की तलाश में है। लेकिन अजय के साथ असली समस्या यह है कि उन्हें यह जानकारी नहीं है कि कैसे आवेदन करें और कैसे लागू करें? नतीजतन, उन्होंने समाचार पत्रों के साथ ही ऑनलाइन में नौकरी खोजने की कोशिश की लेकिन दुर्भाग्य से वह आवश्यक डेटा नहीं पा सके। कुछ समय के लिए इसी प्रक्रिया को दोहराते हुए, अजय को समझा गया कि असली समस्या क्या है और उसे नौकरी नहीं मिल पाई। उन्होंने, फिर यह लिखने का निर्णय लिया कि नियोक्ता किसी कर्मचारी से क्या देख रहे हैं और उनकी सूची इस प्रकार है:

1.आयु / निर्णय लेने की योग्यता / परिपक्वता
2.विशेष क्षेत्र में ज्ञान / योग्यता / अनुभव
3.उनके हितों या भविष्य के लक्ष्यों
4.उनके संपर्क विवरण / शैक्षिक प्रमाण पत्र या अनुभव (यदि कोई हो)


अजय ने अपनी फिर से सीवी / बायो-डेटा तैयार किया, जिसमें उनके संपर्क, योग्यता और अनुभव के बारे में सभी आवश्यक जानकारी शामिल थीं, सभी आवश्यक प्रमाण पत्र एकत्र किए और नौकरी रिक्तियों की एक सूची तैयार की जो उनकी योग्यता, रुचि और अनुभव से मेल खाती हैं। एक बार पूरी तैयारी तैयार हो जाने के बाद, उसने कुछ नौकरियों के लिए आवेदन किया और कुछ हफ्तों के बाद एक मिला।
 
उपरोक्त उदाहरण को सीधे अजय (एक लड़का जिसने अपना 12 वीं का मानक पूरा कर लिया है और नौकरी की तलाश की है) और आपके नए बनाए गए गैर-सरकारी संगठन के साथ तुलना की जा सकती है, जिसके लिए आप एक परियोजना की तलाश कर रहे हैं। आइये तुलना टेबल बनाते हैं:

अजय = आपके नवनिर्मित एनजीओ
 नौकरी की तलाश में = आप अपने नए गैर सरकारी संगठन के लिए एक परियोजना की तलाश कर रहे हैं
 कई नौकरियां हैं लेकिन अजय का चयन नहीं किया जा सकता है = कई परियोजनाएं / योजनाएं हैं लेकिन आपके एनजीओ को कोई नहीं मिला
 अजय ने अपना सीवी/बायो-डेटा तैयार किया = आप अपने एनजीओ प्रोफ़ाइल तैयार किया

अनुदान / परियोजना के लिए आवेदन करने से पहले, आपका पहला कर्तव्य है कि आप अपने एनजीओ के सभी कागजात और प्रमाण पत्र तैयार करें। ये आपका पंजीकरण प्रमाण पत्र, पैन कार्ड, केवाईसी के साथ सदस्य सूची, पिछले वर्ष की लेखापरीक्षित रिपोर्ट, एसोसिएशन के ज्ञापन और उप-कानून, नितीयोग अद्वितीय आईडी, एफसीआरए प्रमाणपत्र आदि हो सकते हैं। ये सब दस्तावेज तैयार हो जाने के बाद, आपको अपने गैर-सरकारी संगठन के लिए उपयुक्त प्रारूप के साथ एक प्रोफ़ाइल तैयार करें जिसमें 9-15 पृष्ठों / स्लाइड्स के भीतर आपकी गैर-सरकारी संस्था के पूरे अवलोकन शामिल हैं।

आपका अगला कदम सभी योजनाओं और अनुदानों के बारे में जानकारी खोजना होगा और उन परियोजनाओं पर लागू होगा जहां आप पात्र हैं। सभी परियोजनाओं पर लागू करना एक अच्छा विचार नहीं है, बल्कि यह आपके बहुमूल्य समय और प्रयास को नष्ट करता है, बल्कि हम आपको उन योजनाओं और अनुदानों के लिए आवेदन करने का सुझाव देते हैं जो आपके संगठन के पात्रता मानदंडों को पूरा करते हैं।

यदि आप सभी परियोजनाओं और अनुदानों के बारे में विस्तृत सूचनाएं प्राप्त करना चाहते हैं, साथ ही चाहते हैं कि आप हमें अपने गैर-सरकारी संगठनों के स्वास्थ्य के विकास में मार्गदर्शन करें तो आप इस लिंक पर जाकर हमारे मानक या प्रीमियम पैकेज की सदस्यता लें या +91 7002484119 पर कॉल करें

नोट: यह आलेख Google अनुवादक का उपयोग करके अनुवादित किया गया है, कृपया हमें नीचे दी गई टिप्पणी पोस्ट करके किसी भी गलती / त्रुटि के लिए सूचित करें

title: How to Get Funds / Grants for New NGOs?
excerpt: Getting funds for new ngos is not an eas...
content:
Getting funds for new ngos is not an easy task. Most of the funding agencies or the ministries of the government always checks the eligibility of the new ngos' before sanctioning a scheme or grant. So, the question is, if your NGO is new how can you get a grant? The answer to the above question is quite simple if we relate it to the following example.
Example begins: There is a boy whose name is Ajay. After completing his 12th standard he is in search of a job. But the real problem with Ajay is, he is not aware where to apply and how to apply? As a result, he tried to search jobs in newspapers as well as online but unfortunately he could not find the required data. Repeating the same process for about some time, Ajay understood what the real problem is and why he could not find a job! He, then decided to write down what exactly the employers are looking from an employee and his list is as follows:
  1. Age / Decision Taking Ability / Maturity
  2. Knowledge / Qualification / Experience in the particular field
  3. Approach
  4. His interests or future goals
  5. His KYC / Educational certificates or experience (if any)
Ajay then prepared his resume / cv / bio-data, which contains all necessary information regarding his contact, qualification and experience, gathered all necessary certificates and prepared a list of job vacancies which matches his qualification, interest and experience. Once the entire preparation was ready, he then applied for a few jobs and got one after a few weeks.
The above example can be directly compared to Ajay (a boy who has just completed his 12th standard and looking for a job) and your newly created NGO for which you are looking for a project. Let us make the comparison table: Ajay = Your newly created NGO Looking for a job = You are looking for a project for your new NGO There are many jobs but Ajay could not get selected = There are many projects / schemes but your Ngo could not find one Ajay prepared his resume/cv= Your NGO profile   Before applying for a grant / project, your first duty is to prepare all the papers and certificates of your NGO. These could be your registration certificate, pan card, member list with KYC, audited report of the last year, memorandum of association and by-laws, Niti Aayog unique id, FCRA certificate, etc. Once all these documents are ready, you need to prepare a profile for your NGO with the appropriate format which contains the entire overview of your NGO within 9-15 pages/slides. Your next step will be to search information regarding all schemes and grants and apply to those projects where you are eligible. Applying to all projects is not a good idea, it destroys your valuable time and effort, rather we suggest you to apply only for those schemes and grants which fulfills the eligibility criteria of your organization. content:
[vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]

REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP) THROUGH E-TENDERING For EMPANELMENT OF RESOURCE ORGANISATIONS UNDER SOCIAL MOBILIZATION & INSTITUTIONAL DEVELOPMENT (SM&ID) DEENDAYAL ANTODAYA YOJNA-NATIONAL URBAN LIVELIHOOD MISSION (DAY-NULM)

 

The Deendayal Antodaya Yojna-National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM) rest on the foundation that the mobilization of urban poor households to form their own institutions is an important investment for an effective and sustainable poverty reduction programme. These institutions of the poor would partner with local self-governments, public service providers, banks, private sector and other mainstream institutions to facilitate delivery of social and economic services to the poor.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column width="1/3"][vc_btn title="Register As a TP (Training Partner)" color="warning" size="lg" align="center" link="url:http%3A%2F%2Findiawebdesigns.in%2Fates-tp-registration-form%2F||target:%20_blank|"][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"][vc_btn title="Request a Call Back" color="violet" size="lg" align="center" link="url:http%3A%2F%2Findiawebdesigns.in%2Frequest-a-call-back%2F||target:%20_blank|"][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"][vc_btn title="Click Here For NGO Guidance Services" color="danger" size="lg" align="center" link="url:http%3A%2F%2Findiawebdesigns.in%2Fngo-guidance-services%2F||target:%20_blank|"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Eligible Organizations: Should be Societies / Institutions / Organizations / Non Government Organizations (registered under society act) / Trust with relevant experience.

Eligibility Criteria: 1. Organisations should have completed at least 5 years of existence as on 31st March, 2017. 2. The organizations should have retaining at least 100 SHGs formed during last 5 years (formed SHG must be under Center or State Govt. schemes/programs/NABARD) with their proper handholding support. The organization should submit documentary evidence in support of the same along with the technical proposal). 3. Bidder Preference will be given to the bidders having past experience in handholding and formation of SHGs in urban areas (Documentary evidence in support of the same should be submitted along with the technical proposal). 4. Availability of appropriate team with qualified professionals and Infrastructure to motivate the urban poor and conduct trainings by drawing lessons from their personal experiences and best practices of their SHGs. 5. Total turnover of the organization is Rs. 10 lakh for the last 5 financial year ending of month 31st march 2017.

Application Fee: Rs 5,000 EMD Value: Rs 10,000

 

Objective of the Assignment : For catalyzing the formation of SHGs and their federations and to promote the financial inclusion of SHG members under DAY-NULM, Resource Organisations (ROs) will be engaged to facilitate the formation of SHGs, their development and bank-linkages, formation of their federations at the area and city levels, training and capacity building, and establishing links to ULBs and to mitigate social, occupational and residential vulnerabilities.

Payouts to the RO: RO will be paid Rs. 10,000/ per SHG for 2 year which includes community mobilization, SHG formation cost, handholding, capacity building/ training of all the SHG members, providing books of account & registers, learning material and technical guidance for entrepreneurial activities, bank linkage, formation of federations Area Level Federations & City Level Federations (ALF & CLF) and other related activities as per guideline (cost of SHG formation and actual tenure of RO will be starts from date of account opening of SHG in banks)

excerpt: For TC to TP Conversion Help Message U...
content:
For TC to TP Conversion Help Message Us Clicking here

This is to notify all the franchise TCs, which have been accredited/conditionally accredited on SMART, that the process for becoming a TP owned centre is now available on SMART. There are 3 options available for the TC to become TP Owned
  1. Become TP Owned with its existing TP
  2. Become TP Owned with any other TP (The TP has to be Deemed Ready on SMART)
  3. Create a new TP and become TP owned with it(The new TP has to become Deemed Ready on SMART before proceeding)
Important Note:
  1. This process includes payment for TP registration and TC re-inspection whichever is applicable.
  2. Once any option is chosen, it will not be rolled back on SMART.
  3. SMART doesn’t mandate a TC to be TP owned, it’s a scheme’s mandate and hence the option will be reflected to all TCs. It’s a TC’s choice to opt for it.
  4. Even after getting converted to a TP owned Centre, the SMART Portal will not guarantee targets under any scheme
  5. TCs who have already converted to a TP owned Centre successfully through the old TC-TP conversion process need not apply again through this new process.
Documents required: The following documents will be checked during physical inspection of the TC to establish ownership of the TP.
  1. Lease Agreement in the form of Rent agreement/Revenue Share agreement for the infrastructure (training space) / sanction or allotment letter from concerned authority (in case of Government Building) / Utility Bills, Tax bill, Govt. Registration certificate in the name of TP. In case infrastructure arrangement includes other training facility (tools equipment, furniture etc.) then same should be included in rent/lease agreement with complete details of the facility.
  2. Facilities related documents:
  • In case facilities (including Furniture, Fixture, and Equipment etc.) is owned by TP then Bill/Invoice or proof of purchase of such tools and equipment.
  • In case facilities (including Furniture, Fixture, and Equipment etc.) is not owned by TP then power of attorney on STAMP Paper of minimum 100 INR duly notarized as per format (Format at the end of this notice) given by NSDC.

3. Employment proof for resources mentioned in the CAAF: Contract/Agreement confirming contractual employment, Letter of Appointment/ Offer Letter duly accepted by employee, employment certificate issued by HR Head confirming on-roll employee.

4. Undertaking/NOC/Declaration by current franchise TC mentioning his willingness to convert into TP owned TC on STAMP Paper of minimum 100 INR duly notarized as per format given by NSDC.(Format at the end of this notice)
